_about: One source for the per-app connect steps: /get-started renders each app's list from here (hack_connect_steps.go), and the Website screen (participant-website.js) shows the tab apps with the publish steps below. html is our own trusted markup.
signin_hint: Sign in with {email}, the email you use here, so {app} can see your team.

publish.html: Paste this into a new chat. {app} builds the page and publishes it to your team site.
Watch this page. It says Connected as soon as {app} reaches your team, and Published when the site is live.

apps.label: Claude

connect.html: Open Claude, then Settings, then Connectors, then Browse connectors.
Search for Simple Hack, choose Connect, sign in, then choose Allow.

connect.html: Open ChatGPT Plugins.
Click Add, then choose Add custom MCP server.
Name it Simple Hack, paste this address, and save.
A sign-in window opens. Sign in with Google or an email code, then choose Allow.
Open grok.com/connectors, then New Connector → Custom.
Name it Simple Hack, paste this address into Server URL, and click Add Connector:
Sign in once in the Simple Hack window that opens, with Google or an email code, then choose Allow.
Open the Command Palette, run MCP: Add Server and choose HTTP.
Paste this address, name it simple-hack, save and start the server. Accept the trust prompt.
Sign in once in the Simple Hack window that opens, with Google or an email code, then choose Allow. Use Copilot Chat’s agent mode.
In Muse, open Settings, then Connectors, then Add custom connector.
Paste this address as the MCP URL:
Muse asks for a Client ID. Type this, not your email:
Sign in once in the Simple Hack window that opens, with Google or an email code, then choose Allow.
On a computer, open gemini.google.com, then Settings, then Connected Apps.
Under Custom apps, choose Add a custom app, paste this address, and choose Next:
Sign in once in the Simple Hack window that opens, with Google or an email code, then choose Allow.
Open Connectors, choose Add Connector, then the Custom MCP Connector tab.
Name it simplehack, paste this address as the Server URL, and choose Connect:
Sign in once in the Simple Hack window that opens, with Google or an email code, then choose Allow.
